arxiv-1911-00295.title: Practice meets Principle: Tracking Software and Data Citations to Zenodo DOIs
arxiv-1911-00295.creator: Stephanie van de Sandt, Lars Holm Nielsen, Alexandros Ioannidis, Dr. August Muench, Edwin Henneken, Dr. Alberto Accomazzi, Chiara Bigarella, Jose Benito Gonzalez Lopez, Sünje Dallmeier-Tiessen
arxiv-1911-00295.description: Abstract Data and software citations are crucial for the transparency of research results and for the transmission of credit. But they are hard to track, because of the absence of a common citation standard. As a consequence, the FORCE11 recently proposed data and software citation principles as guidance for authors.

arxiv-2205-13355.title: Single-pass Nyström approximation in mixed precision
arxiv-2205-13355.creator: Erin Carson, Ieva Daužickaitė
arxiv-2205-13355.description: Abstract Low rank matrix approximations appear in a number of scientific computing applications. We consider the Nyström method for approximating a positive semidefinite matrix A A . In the case that A A is very large or its entries can only be accessed once, a single-pass version may be necessary.

arxiv-2206-06224.title: Reactive control of 2 n ​ d 2^{nd} Mack mode in a supersonic boundary layer with freestream velocity/density variations
arxiv-2206-06224.creator: Pierre Nibourel 1, Colin Leclercq 1, Fabrice Demourant 2, Eric Garnier 1, Denis Sipp 1
arxiv-2206-06224.description: Abstract We consider closed-loop control of a two-dimensional supersonic boundary layer at M = 4.5 M=4.5 that aims at reducing the linear growth of second Mack mode instabilities. These instabilities are first characterized with local spatial and global resolvent analyses, which allow to refine the control strategy and to select appropriate actuators and sensors.

arxiv-2207-05970.title: Impacts of anomaly on nuclear and neutron star equation of state based on a parity doublet model
arxiv-2207-05970.creator: Bikai Gao, Takuya Minamikawa, Toru Kojo, Masayasu Harada
arxiv-2207-05970.description: Abstract We examine the role of the U ​ ( 1 ) A U(1)_{A} anomaly in a parity doublet model of nucleons which include the chiral variant and invariant masses. Our model expresses the U ​ ( 1 ) A U(1)_{A} anomaly by the Kobayashi-Maskawa-’t Hooft (KMT) interaction in the mesonic sector.

arxiv-2207-11166.title: METER-ML: A Multi-Sensor Earth Observation Benchmark for Automated Methane Source Mapping
arxiv-2207-11166.creator: Bryan Zhu, Nicholas Lui, Jeremy Irvin, Jimmy Le, Sahil Tadwalkar, Chenghao Wang, Zutao Ouyang, Frankie Y. Liu, Andrew Y. Ng, Robert B. Jackson
arxiv-2207-11166.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Bryan Zhu, Nicholas Lui, Jeremy Irvin, Jimmy Le, Sahil Tadwalkar, Chenghao Wang, Zutao Ouyang, Frankie Y. Liu, Andrew Y. Ng, Robert B. Jackson. Reducing methane emissions is essential for mitigating global warming. To attribute methane emissions to their sources, a comprehensive dataset of methane source infrastructure is necessary.

arxiv-2212-04791.title: Learning optimal policies in potential Mean Field Games: Smoothed Policy Iteration algorithms
arxiv-2212-04791.creator: Qing Tang, Jiahao Song
arxiv-2212-04791.description: Abstract We introduce two Smoothed Policy Iteration algorithms ( SPI s) as rules for learning policies and methods for computing Nash equilibria in second order potential Mean Field Games (MFGs). Global convergence is proved if the coupling term in the MFG system satisfy the Lasry Lions monotonicity condition.

arxiv-2308-12217.title: Funnel MPC for nonlinear systems with arbitrary relative degree Note: This work was funded by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) – Project-ID 471539468.
arxiv-2308-12217.creator: Thomas Berger, Dario Dennstädt
arxiv-2308-12217.description: Abstract The model predictive control (MPC) scheme funnel MPC enables output tracking of smooth reference signals with prescribed error bounds for nonlinear multi-input multi-output systems with stable internal dynamics. Earlier works achieved the control objective for system with relative degree restricted to one or incorporated additional feasibility constraints in the optimal control problem.

arxiv-2311-15373.title: Confidence Is All You Need for MI Attacks (Student Abstract)
arxiv-2311-15373.creator: Abhishek Sinha, Himanshi Tibrewal, Mansi Gupta, Nikhar Waghela, Shivank Garg
arxiv-2311-15373.description: Abstract In this evolving era of machine learning security, membership inference attacks have emerged as a potent threat to the confidentiality of sensitive data. In this attack, adversaries aim to determine whether a particular point was used during the training of a target model.

arxiv-2507-10188.title: Well-posedness of an optical flow based optimal control formulation for image registration
arxiv-2507-10188.creator: Johannes Haubner, Christian Clason
arxiv-2507-10188.description: Abstract We consider image registration as an optimal control problem using an optical flow formulation, i.e., we discuss an optimization problem that is governed by a linear hyperbolic transport equation. Requiring Lipschitz continuity of the vector fields that parametrize the transformation leads to an optimization problem in a non-reflexive Banach space.

arxiv-2511-12785.title: Lightweight Optimal-Transport Harmonization on Edge Devices
arxiv-2511-12785.creator: Maria Larchenko, Dmitry Guskov, Alexander Lobashev, Georgy Derevyanko
arxiv-2511-12785.description: Abstract Color harmonization adjusts the colors of an inserted object so that it perceptually matches the surrounding image, resulting in a seamless composite. The harmonization problem naturally arises in augmented reality (AR), yet harmonization algorithms are not currently integrated into AR pipelines because real-time solutions are scarce.

arxiv-2512-16351.title: Survey of Mathematical Models of and Numerical Methods for Fluid Dynamics Water Engineering
arxiv-2512-16351.creator: Anshu Kumar, Kemi Olimba, Vyacheslav Kungurtsev, Fabio V. Difonzo
arxiv-2512-16351.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anshu Kumar, Kemi Olimba, Vyacheslav Kungurtsev, Fabio V. Difonzo. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) has become a cornerstone of modern water engineering, providing quantitative tools for the analysis, prediction, and management of complex hydraulic systems across a wide range of spatial and temporal scales. This survey reviews the mathematical models and numerical methods that underpin CFD applications in water engineering, from depth-averaged formulations such as the shallow water equations to fully three-dimensional Navier–Stokes models, as well as selected alternative modeling approaches.

pmc-10672434.title: Association between Neuron-Specific Enolase, Memory Function, and Postoperative Delirium after Transfemoral Aortic Valve Replacement
pmc-10672434.creator: Jonathan Nübel, Charlotte Buhre, Meike Hoffmeister, Stefanie Oess, Oliver Labrenz, Kerstin Jost, Michael Hauptmann, Julika Schön, Georg Fritz, Christian Butter, Anja Haase-Fielitz, Stephen Clark
pmc-10672434.description: Introduction: Although transfemoral aortic valve replacement (TAVR) is a safe treatment for elderly patients with severe aortic valve stenosis, postoperative microembolism has been described. In this secondary endpoint analysis of the POST-TAVR trial, we aimed to investigate whether changes in neuron-specific enolase (NSE)—a biomarker of neuronal damage—are associated with changes in memory function or postoperative delirium (POD).

pmc-10740061.title: Transmembrane behaviors and quantitative structure–activity relationship of dietary flavonoids in the presence of intestinal digestive products from different carbohydrate sources based on in vitro and in silico analysis
pmc-10740061.creator: Xiaojing Liu, Shuang Ma, Yuanyue Zhang, Yishan Fu, Shengbao Cai
pmc-10740061.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Highlights•Digestive products of rice (RD) and wheat (WD) affect flavonoid bioavailability.•WD has a better promotive effect on the bioavailability of most flavonoids.•Reducing sugars of carbohydrate digestion may influence flavonoid bioavailability.•Flavonoid structures contribute significantly to their bioavailabilities.Keywords: Bioavailability, Dietary flavonoids, Wheat flour, Rice flour, In vitro simulated digestion, 3D-QSAR Introduction Plant polyphenols are a prominent category of secondary metabolites, encompassing various subgroups, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids and lignans.

pmc-11312067.title: The Potential Correlation between Bacterial Diversity and the Characteristic Volatile Flavor Compounds of Sichuan Sauce-Flavored Sausage
pmc-11312067.creator: Lili Ji, Yanan Zhou, Qing Nie, Yi Luo, Rui Yang, Jun Kang, Yinfeng Zhao, Mengzhao Zeng, Yinhua Jia, Shirong Dong, Ling Gan, Jiamin Zhang
pmc-11312067.description: The distinctive taste of Sichuan sauce-flavored sausage comes from an intricate microbial metabolism. The correlation between microbial composition and distinct flavor components has not been researched. The study used headspace solid-phase microextraction action with gas chromatography mass spectrometry to find flavor components and high-throughput sequencing of 16S rRNA to look at the diversity and succession of microbial communities.

pmc-11369119.title: Human cytomegalovirus harnesses host L1 retrotransposon for efficient replication
pmc-11369119.creator: Sung-Yeon Hwang, Hyewon Kim, Danielle Denisko, Boxun Zhao, Dohoon Lee, Jiseok Jeong, Jinuk Kim, Kiwon Park, Junhyun Park, Dongjoon Jeong, Sehong Park, Hee-Jung Choi, Sun Kim, Eunjung Alice Lee, Kwangseog Ahn
pmc-11369119.description: Genetic parasites, including viruses and transposons, exploit components from the host for their own replication. However, little is known about virus-transposon interactions within host cells. Here, we discover a strategy where human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) hijacks L1 retrotransposon encoded protein during its replication cycle.

pmc-11676699.title: Comparative Transcriptome Analysis Highlights the Role of NlABCG14 in the Honeydew Production of Virulent Brown Planthoppers (Nilaparvata lugens Stål) to Resistant Rice Variety
pmc-11676699.creator: Shengli Jing, Mengjia Geng, Bojie Lu, Bing Wu, Yuhan Shao, Chenxi Li, Qingqing Yu, Jingang Xu, Wei Hu, Qingsong Liu, Bin Yu, Gaelle Le Goff
pmc-11676699.description: Simple SummaryThe brown planthopper (BPH) is a major threat to rice crops in Asia, particularly due to its ability to overcome resistant rice varieties designed to control it. This study aimed to understand the various responses of different virulent BPH populations feeding on resistant rice, focusing on biotype Y, known for its strong virulence against YHY15 rice.

pmc-13587340.title: Laparoscopic versus open emergency colonic resection for obstruction: a multicentre retrospective cohort study
pmc-13587340.creator: Joline de Groof, Silvia Marchesi, Ellie Pearce, Timothy Rockall, Tomas Vedin, Erik Agger
pmc-13587340.description: BackgroundDespite its established benefits in elective colorectal surgery, the adoption of laparoscopy in the emergency setting remains limited. This retrospective international multicentre study assesses laparoscopic and open colonic resection in patients with acute benign or malignant colonic obstruction.MethodsPatients were included between 2022 and 2023. Intraperitoneal free air on imaging was an exclusion criterion.
